lines.text: He tripped in the school play!
That blooper made the whole class laugh.

data.define: A silly mistake, especially one that is caught on video.

example.text: That blooper made the whole class laugh.

misuse.text: Don't call a serious mistake a 'blooper'.
misuse.why: It means a small, funny error.

data.l1_hook: वह स्कूल नाटक में ठोकर खा गया! यह एक 'blooper' है!
data.l1_ex: वह "blooper" पूरी कक्षा को हँसा दिया।
